nodes.label: Square, full-bleed reference format
nodes.rationale: All eight streams measure 1080×1080 H.264 with reported 60 fps and 44.1 kHz stereo AAC. Reported frame rate does not identify source rate or interpolation.

nodes.label: Concrete action or contradiction before a dossier
nodes.rationale: Use a meaningful, visible event to raise the first question; dialogue-led V5 and delayed recognized speech in V6 preclude a compulsory narrator-at-zero rule.

nodes.label: Intentional cold open and delayed backstory
nodes.rationale: V1 pays a physical price before resetting to the assassin/hotel/bounty explanation at 31.38–43.80; planners must represent the chronological reset.

nodes.label: Causal beats with distinct escalation phases
nodes.rationale: Each action changes the situation and creates a constraint answered by the next action. V5 fighting rounds, V7 defense and V2 access/escape have differentiated phases.

nodes.label: Source-grounded nouns, verbs and visible objects
nodes.rationale: Match narration to the specific source action, hands, faces and story objects rather than a generic action-footage pool.

nodes.label: Selected original dialogue with editorial room
nodes.rationale: Short greetings, technical conversation, amulet opening and the policing argument can carry story beats. ASR does not certify speaker identity or exact source/voiceover separation.

Automatic ASR; merged speakers require correction

nodes.label: Story-selected, varied ending modes
nodes.rationale: Threat, ironic reveal, reflection, thematic realization and full resolution all occur. V5 and V6 are held-out counterexamples to a universal cliffhanger template.

nodes.label: Compact white uppercase captions
nodes.rationale: Samples show bold, slanted-looking white uppercase text, usually one or two lines, around 60–65% image height. Exact font, baseline and animation are unverified; align to final audio and test phone readability.
nodes.measurement_status: Sampled visual estimate, not exact font/baseline identification

nodes.label: Automatic speech and scene measurements require review
nodes.rationale: ASR can merge turns, mishear names and omit audible tails; scene-change candidates are not reviewed cuts. Sampled images do not establish all transitions, effects or exact crop algorithms.

nodes.label: Evidence-linked story beats and timed edit decisions
nodes.rationale: Preserve source ID, original span and supported sentence for every beat; flag unsupported generated claims. Keep source inventory, scene index, outline, script, narration, edit list, captions, render and QA.

nodes.label: Continuous final playback and media QA
nodes.rationale: Check profile, action visibility, dialogue turns, captions, loudness and a complete ending, then play the whole first render. Contact sheets, graph queries and automatic meters do not replace this review.

nodes.label: Separate narration, retained dialogue, music and effects
nodes.rationale: Duck competing material when dialogue matters. Initial −14 LUFS and ≤−1.5 dBTP is a chosen output policy, not a uniform measured reference setting; audition the mix.

nodes.label: Renewed-threat ending
nodes.rationale: An active bounty, next robbery or stronger dispatched assassin creates a new immediate threat.

nodes.label: Reveal or unresolved-identity ending
nodes.rationale: V8 ends on identity/dramatic irony rather than a conventional victory card.

nodes.label: Reflection ending
nodes.rationale: V4 ends with wounded reunion and reflection.

nodes.label: Thematic-payoff ending
nodes.rationale: V6 ends with a rookie reaching a changed understanding.

nodes.label: Resolved-payoff ending
nodes.rationale: V5 completes victory, revenge, goodbye and a new life.

nodes.label: yt-dlp/yt-dlp
nodes.rationale: Optional source acquisition; direct-file and GitHub-release inputs remain alternatives. Installation does not establish YouTube network access.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: FFmpeg/FFmpeg
nodes.rationale: Core renderer, media validation and cover-frame extraction; concrete source ranges and filters followed by ffprobe validation. Build configuration determines license obligations.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: Breakthrough/PySceneDetect
nodes.rationale: CPU-downscaled shot-boundary candidates; recommended AdaptiveDetector for fast camera movement. Visual transitions are not story beats.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: SYSTRAN/faster-whisper
nodes.rationale: CPU INT8 transcription and verification with approximate word timing; authored script text and alignment should prevent copying ASR errors into captions.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: m-bain/whisperX
nodes.rationale: Optional forced alignment; extra model cost. Numbers/currency may remain unaligned and missing timings require handling. Diarization need not run for one narrator.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: mlfoundations/open_clip
nodes.rationale: Optional text-to-frame/shot ranking in sparse CPU batches with compatible pinned inference. Similarity is not proof that an event occurred; preserve continuity and source-time constraints.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: resemble-ai/chatterbox
nodes.rationale: Reference-conditioned narration; retain Top10's known pin and three samples with replaceable TTS. README says retired research and unmaintained as of August 2026 despite recent metadata activity; quality/speed need auditions.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: ollama/ollama
nodes.rationale: Configurable local serving endpoint and schema-validated JSON script plans. Runtime depends on actual model size/quantization/context; server choice does not establish script quality.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: Zulko/moviepy
nodes.rationale: Useful for effects prototypes, but excluded from the first production dependency set due to array/import-export overhead versus direct FFmpeg; v2 breaks v1 APIs.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: remotion-dev/remotion
nodes.rationale: Optional future React/browser graphics layer, excluded from first dependency set. Custom license is not standard permissive OSS; eligibility/version requires rechecking.
nodes.claim_scope: Report recommendation; no creator-tool attribution; inspected revision is not an upgrade recommendation

nodes.label: faster-whisper small.en
nodes.rationale: The report explicitly used small.en on CPU int8 for English ASR; not a claim about the creator's transcription tools.

nodes.label: Chatterbox Nano
nodes.rationale: 110M CPU-oriented option; upstream 3× realtime on eight CPU cores is unbenchmarked here.

nodes.label: Chatterbox Turbo
nodes.rationale: 350M variant; actual speed and voice quality require auditions.

nodes.label: Original and multilingual Chatterbox variants
nodes.rationale: Heavier alternatives described by the report; no claim that any is the creator's model.

nodes.label: Warguy reference sample
nodes.rationale: One of the existing Top10 voice samples recommended for the narration interface; sample name does not identify the creator's authentic narrator.

nodes.label: Kit Laser reference sample
nodes.rationale: One of the existing Top10 voice samples recommended for the narration interface; spelling follows this report.

nodes.label: Female reference sample
nodes.rationale: One of the existing Top10 voice samples recommended for the narration interface; no verified identification of the reference creator's female voice.

nodes.label: Adaptive cut detection for action
nodes.rationale: AdaptiveDetector handles fast camera movement better than ContentDetector according to upstream documentation; boundaries still need verification.

nodes.label: Replaceable forced word-alignment stage
nodes.rationale: Word-accurate captions may warrant optional model/dependency cost; missing alignments must remain explicit.

nodes.label: Evidence-grounded structured beat plans
nodes.rationale: Use a configurable local model endpoint and validated JSON schema; ground scripts in source evidence.

nodes.label: Source-frame covers and deterministic text composition
nodes.rationale: Prefer clear source frames with crop/readability scoring and deterministic text before adding generative-image or browser-render stacks.
